notes: When a render stops making progress, Crisp now says so instead of leaving the bar ticking. A job that has not moved for a while reads "nothing has moved for 6m 40s" and the line turns amber, so a render that is stuck looks different from one that is simply slow — until now they looked identical, and a frozen job could sit at 77% with nothing on screen to tell you. It only speaks up once a job has been still for a while, so ordinary slow stretches stay quiet. Nothing else changes on screen and nothing got slower.
